newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Long-term PHIBOR slightly higher, others steady.
newsitem.headline: Long-term PHIBOR slightly higher, others steady.

text.p: Long-term Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were slightly firmer on Monday as some banks nudged them higher in anticipation of a possible uptick in the Treasury bill rates, traders said.
"Some believe that the spot T-bill rates will go higher in today's auction ... But others believe otherwise, so there was just a slight uptick," one trader said.
Other rates were steady, except for the one-week PHIBOR which went back to its previous rate of 10.25 percent.
PHIBOR are average swap quotes of 20 banks operating in the Philippines.
